name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio: Mateo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Buenos Aires, where he spent countless hours tinkering with go-karts. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he honed his skills in various racing series across South America, working his way up to leading technical roles. Known for his innovative approach and meticulous attention to detail, Mateo believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers can freely explore new ideas and push the boundaries of performance. His focus is on leveraging data-driven insights to optimize car setup and improve overall team efficiency, striving for incremental gains that ultimately translate to race wins. He joined Richard Childress Racing looking for a challenge to apply his management and technical background at the highest level.

physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a mate (Argentinian tea) during every strategy meeting.
